race.description: Cooper Commercial Race Callers Cup Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: AUTUMN GALE (8) has been in the placings at his last two starts, finishing third last time when he was prominent throughout over 1400m at Rockhampton. Looks the runner in this line-up with the most upside and is a likely improver with strong prospects. PLAYFUL PUZZLE (11) found the line nicely to grab third last time out over 1625m at this track. Has a win and three placings at this journey from seven starts and shapes as one of the main contenders. BOLE LE (2) was just out of the money two runs back then again just missed the frame last start over 1625m at this circuit, beaten 4.5 lengths into fourth. Well placed and can figure in the finish this time. BIG BOY GEORGE (1) drifted back and never threatened when seventh last start over 1640m here. Looks well placed against this field so expect a better run this time.
